title.en: Himalayas, Plains, Plateau, Islands and Coasts
title.as: হিমালয়, সমভূমি, মালভূমি, দ্বীপ আৰু উপকূল

description.en: Important questions on the physical divisions of India - Himalayas, plains, plateau, islands and coasts - for Assam competitive exams.
description.as: ভাৰতৰ ভৌগোলিক বিভাগ — হিমালয়, সমভূমি, মালভূমি, দ্বীপ আৰু উপকূল — সম্পৰ্কে অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাৰ বাবে গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ প্ৰশ্ন।

q.en: What is the total length of the Himalayas?
What are the three main parallel ranges of the Himalayas?
q.as: হিমালয়ৰ তিনিটা মূল সমান্তৰাল শৃংখল কি কি?

a.en: Himadri (Greater Himalayas), Himachal (Lesser Himalayas) and Shiwalik (Outer Himalayas).
a.as: হিমাদ্ৰি (মহান হিমালয়), হিমাচল (ক্ষুদ্ৰ হিমালয়) আৰু শিৱালিক (বাহ্যিক হিমালয়)।

q.en: Which is the highest peak of India?

a.en: K2 (Godwin Austen), at 8,611 metres, in the Karakoram range.
a.as: কে২ (গডউইন অষ্টেন), ৮,৬১১ মিটাৰ উচ্চতাৰ, কাৰাকোৰাম শৃংখলাত।

q.en: Which is the highest peak of the Great Himalayas located entirely in India?
q.as: সম্পূৰ্ণৰূপে ভাৰতত অৱস্থিত মহান হিমালয়ৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ শৃঙ্গ কোনটো?

q.en: Which is the highest peak of the Eastern Himalayas?
What is the average height of the Himadri range?
What are the longitudinal divisions of the Himalayas?

a.en: Punjab Himalayas, Kumaon Himalayas, Nepal Himalayas and Assam Himalayas.
a.as: পঞ্জাব হিমালয়, কুমায়ুন হিমালয়, নেপাল হিমালয় আৰু অসম হিমালয়।

q.en: Which is the largest delta of India?

a.en: The Sundarbans delta, formed by the Ganga and the Brahmaputra.
a.as: গংগা আৰু ব্ৰহ্মপুত্ৰই গঠন কৰা সুন্দৰবন বদ্বীপ।

q.en: What is the total length of the Indian coastline?
Which is the western coastal plain of India?

a.en: The Konkan coast in the north and the Malabar coast in the south.
a.as: উত্তৰত কংকন উপকূল আৰু দক্ষিণত মালাবাৰ উপকূল।

q.en: Which is the eastern coastal plain of India?

a.en: The Coromandel coast (south) and the Northern Circars (north).

q.en: Which is the largest island group of India?

a.en: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands in the Bay of Bengal.

q.en: Which is the largest island of India?

a.en: Middle Andaman island in the Andaman group.

q.en: Which is the largest island of the Lakshadweep group?
What are the Lakshadweep islands made of?
Which is the northernmost point of India?

a.en: Indira Col (Siachen), in the Karakoram range.

q.en: Which is the southernmost point of India?

a.en: Indira Point, in the Nicobar Islands.

q.en: Which is the easternmost point of India?
Which is the westernmost point of India?
Which is the highest plateau of India?
What is the Deccan Plateau made of?
Which is the highest peak of the Deccan Plateau?
What are the western and eastern edges of the Deccan Plateau called?
q.as: ডেক্কান মালভূমিৰ পশ্চিম আৰু পূব কাষ কাক বোলা হয়?

a.en: The Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats.

q.en: Which is the highest peak of the Western Ghats?
Which is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats?
What is the name of the northern plains of India?
What are the three sections of the northern plains?
q.as: উত্তৰ সমভূমিৰ তিনিটা খণ্ড কি কি?

a.en: Bhabar, Terai and the alluvial plains.

q.en: Which is the largest river island in the world?
Which is the smallest state of India by area?
q.as: মাটিকালিৰ দিশত ভাৰতৰ ক্ষুদ্ৰতম ৰাজ্য কোনখন?

q.en: Which is the largest state of India by area?
q.as: মাটিকালিৰ দিশত ভাৰতৰ বৃহত্তম ৰাজ্য কোনখন?

q.en: Which is the longest coastline state of India?
q.as: ভাৰতৰ দীঘলতম উপকূল থকা ৰাজ্য কোনখন?

q.en: What is the total area of India?
Which is the widest part of the Himalayas?

a.en: The Kashmir Himalayas, about 400 kilometres wide.

q.en: Which is the narrowest part of the Himalayas?

a.en: The Assam Himalayas, about 100 to 200 kilometres wide.
a.as: অসম হিমালয়, প্ৰায় ১০০ৰ পৰা ২০০ কিলোমিটাৰ বহল।

q.en: Which is the famous pass connecting India with Tibet?
q.as: ভাৰত আৰু তিব্বত সংযোগী বিখ্যাত গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

a.en: The Nathu La pass in Sikkim.
